# Workplace AI

> AI Workplace Productivity Assistant — automate emails, meeting summaries, planning, research, and chat in one clean SaaS dashboard.

## Pages
- [Dashboard](/): Overview of all AI productivity tools.
- [Smart Email Generator](/email): Draft professional emails with structured prompts.
- [Meeting Notes Summarizer](/meetings): Convert raw notes into decisions and action items.
- [AI Task Planner](/planner): Break goals into milestones and tasks.
- [AI Research Assistant](/research): Get balanced briefings on any topic.
- [AI Chatbot](/chat): Conversational workplace copilot.
